Seris 0.1.0 is the first stable release for macOS Apple Silicon, focused on AI conversation, real market data and local strategy backtests.

### Supported features

- Persistent AI conversations with streaming replies, tool approvals and cloud or compatible model configuration. API keys remain in the macOS credential store.
- Real market search, watchlists, candlestick charts and chart-attached conversations. Supported sources include Binance spot and USDT traditional-finance perpetuals, Hyperliquid and Hyperliquid xyz, with Longbridge market data available after account authorization.
- AI can resolve a market, retrieve candles and open the corresponding chart. Instrument hints show only the icon and name; full context remains attached to messages.
- Reviewed TypeScript strategy drafts, Binance spot backtests and persistent metrics, fills and charts. User strategies and results survive application upgrades.
- Chinese and English interfaces and conditional price alerts while the app is running.

### Changes from Beta.6

- Remove unfinished Automation and Portfolio navigation entries.
- Exclude simulated account, brokerage and wallet tools, placeholder funding and desktop-control tools, and their bundled skill advertisements from the release catalog. Funding guidance uses real venue tools.
- Make the assistant's supported capabilities explicit and align installation, support and security documentation with the stable release.
- Publish numeric version tags as stable GitHub Releases; prerelease versions retain their prerelease status.

### Validation

- 81 automated regressions, TypeScript checks and production dependency audit passed, including rejection of unavailable legacy tools and absence of unfinished navigation in both languages.
- The complete application signature, bundled runtime, native cold start, saved configuration, crash recovery, credential IPC and exit cleanup were verified.
- Upgrade checks used the published Beta.6 bundle and the 0.1.0 bundle with their own Node runtimes and disposable data. Conversations, model metadata, watchlists, strategy source and a real Binance candle backtest remained intact after upgrade and after removal of the old runtime.

### Installation and scope

- **macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon).** Quit the old app, open the DMG and drag Seris to Applications, replacing the previous app. Local user data remains separate from the app bundle.
- **Ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized.** After the first blocked launch, approve Seris in **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**. See [Apple's instructions](https://support.apple.com/102445). An upgrade may ask for keychain authorization for an existing model credential.
- Traditional-finance perpetual quotes are contract prices, with the venue identified in the workspace. Some venues require ticker codes rather than company names; use **V** for the Binance Visa perpetual.
- Strategies are local backtests. This release does not execute live orders, transfer wallet funds or provide a connected portfolio. Alerts run only while Seris is running; data availability depends on the provider, region and account permissions.
